C1515.title: When 'Sexual Harassment' Happens in Virtual Worlds
C1515.summary: The report examines incidents of sexual harassment occurring in virtual environments such as the metaverse, including unwanted physical touching, stalking, verbal harassment, and the display of explicit images.
